value.rationale: The two-line parity set family arises naturally from projective incidence-code geometry. Its complete pure face complex has the sharp full-line obstruction and two projective facet orbits; the explicit strict VC=4, Littlestone=5 separation is an additional structural online-learning phenomenon not captured by weight enumerators or scalar VC bounds. This natural complete small-field classification is a baseline for extension to larger projective planes, not an arbitrary parametrized slice.
